ache.title: Maitha protects your team. Who protects your wallet?
ache.note: Maitha’s skills, traits and rank talents, all in ten minutes. Rank talents are the bit to watch: in games like this they usually grow with more copies of the same character, so “maximize her potential” quietly means more pulls. A defender who shields your team is lovely. Make sure someone shields you too.
ache.tip: Enjoy her at the level you have. Maximum potential is a number, not a feeling.
lines: a defender! finally someone on my side
maximize potential usually means pull again
I protect wallets. it’s my side job

textData.text: Hello YouTube! In this first character guide for Sword of Convallaria, we dive into Maitha's skills, traits, and strategies. As a defender character, Maitha excels in protecting your team and providing support buffs. I'll cover her faction affiliations, skills, rank talents, and provide gameplay tips to make the most of her abilities. Whether you're new to the game or looking to optimize your strategy, this guide will help you maximize Maitha's potential in just 10 minutes. Enjoy and don't forget to like, subscribe, and comment!
